topic: 模式分离与模式补全：DG-CA3 双引擎记忆架构

sources.title: Pattern separation in the dentate gyrus and CA3 of the hippocampus
sources.authors: Leutgeb JK, Leutgeb S, Moser MB, Moser EI
sources.key_contribution: DG 对微小环境差异产生全局重映射，CA3 产生率重映射；提出 DG decorrelation + CA3 招募两种分离机制
used_for: DG vs CA3 pattern separation mechanisms
foundational evidence for DG pattern separation

sources.title: Young dentate granule cells mediate pattern separation, whereas old granule cells facilitate pattern completion
sources.authors: Nakashiba T, Cushman JD, Pelkey KA, et al.
sources.key_contribution: 年轻 DGC（≤4周）执行模式分离，老 DGC 执行模式补全；DG-TeTX 三转基因小鼠因果验证

sources.title: Parallel processing streams in the hippocampus
sources.authors: Lee H, GoodSmith D, Knierim JJ
sources.key_contribution: DG + 近端 CA3 = 模式分离单元（LEC/物体）；远端 CA3 = 模式补全吸引子（MEC/空间）

sources.title: The mechanisms for pattern completion and pattern separation in the hippocampus
sources.key_contribution: CA3 定量 Hopfield 模型：12K 递归侧支，46 苔藓纤维，~36K 记忆容量；DG 竞争性学习扩展重编码；穿孔路径双角色

sources.title: Structure, biophysics, and circuit function of a 'giant' cortical presynaptic terminal
sources.key_contribution: 苔藓纤维末梢的分子结构（CaV 2.1 钙通道，短期易化）使其成为强大的'去整合者'突触，决定 DG→CA3 的随机化特性

sources.title: Maladaptation of dentate gyrus mossy cells mediates contextual discrimination deficit after traumatic stress
sources.authors: Jeong M, Jang JH, Oh SJ, Park J, Lee J, Hwang S, Oh YS
sources.key_contribution: 创伤 → 苔藓细胞受抑制 → 粒细胞集合变大重叠 → 情景区分失败 → 恐惧泛化；提供 PTSD 恐惧泛化的细胞机制
sources.note: 未读取全文，基于摘要；单一实验室啮齿类研究，需独立复现

sources.title: Memory processing by hippocampal adult-born neurons
sources.authors: Chavan P, Kitamura T, Sakaguchi M
sources.key_contribution: ABGCs 支持模式分离；年轻 ABGCs 的关键期特性（低阈值、高可塑性）；REM 睡眠中的记忆巩固功能；神经发生下降与老年记忆衰退/AD 相关
used_for: REM sleep consolidation role of ABGCs

sources.title: Pattern Separation Underpins Expectation-Modulated Memory
sources.authors: Frank D, Montemurro MA, Montaldi D
sources.key_contribution: 人类 fMRI 证据：DG/CA3 模式分离中介预期违背增强记忆效应；对相似刺激效果最强
used_for: human fMRI evidence for pattern separation
